resources.string: Clashcards
Playing Solo Mode
1. You will be shown a card with a text prompt.
2. Aim to guess what could be the answer to this prompt - it could be something such as a definition of the word in the prompt.
3. When you know the answer, flip your phone towards you. Alternatively, you can press the screen.
4. On flip, the answer is now visible to you.
5. Using the rating system on the bottom on the page, select the difficulty of the card based on what you answered.
Playing Duo Mode
1. With 2 people, one person will be the \'Describer\', and the other \'Guesser\'.
2. The Guesser will be the one who will hold the phone, up to their forehead. The screen faces the Describer.
3. The Describer can see the prompt on the held phone, and will begin to describe the concept without explicitly telling the Guesser.
4. The Guesser has until the timer runs out to figure out the answer to the prompt.
5. When the timer runs out, or if the Guesser already gets the correct answer, they will tilt the phone according to their response: Down for Correct, and Up for False.
6. This will repeat until the deck is complete.
Playing Clash Mode
1. One team sets up the game by selecting \'Clash Mode\' in the desired Deck.
2. Once the lobby is set up, the other team can join the game via the homepage of the application (Join Clash).
3. The host team will accept the requests, and set the timer for both teams.
4. When ready, the teams will split into their roles as per a Duo mode game - one person will be the \'Describer\', and the other \'Guesser\'.
5. Play out this game and see who can get a better score!
